## 🎯 Our Mission

Moovv is a healthtech platform that uses AI to deliver personalized musculoskeletal (MSK) and mobility care. We help people move better, recover faster, and stay active through intelligent video analysis and guided exercise programs.

## 🛠️ What We're Building

| Area | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **AI Video Analysis** | Real-time movement assessment using computer vision |
| **Personalized Programs** | Adaptive exercise routines tailored to individual needs |
| **Provider Tools** | Dashboards for clinicians to monitor patient progress |
| **Partner Integrations** | APIs for health systems and wellness platforms |

## 💻 Tech Stack

```
Node.js • TypeScript • AWS Lambda • CDK • Prisma • React • Flutter
```
